## Why
Replaces the Phase 1/2 flat-grey GBA placeholder with real silhouettes and verified variant colours, at the same depth slot gives GB/GBC/GBA carts (docs/PLAN.md Phase 4 deliverables, Build steps 22, 23, 25).

## Scope
- [x] Assets in `crates/slot-ui/assets/`: `nes_cart.svg`, `nes_cart_detail.svg`, `famicom_cart.svg`, `famicom_cart_detail.svg`, `snes_cart.svg`, `snes_cart_detail.svg`, `sfc_cart.svg`, `sfc_cart_detail.svg`, `lettering_nes.png`, `lettering_snes.png` (lettering generated by extending `slot: crates/slot-ui/examples/lettering.rs`).
- [x] `patches/0012-cart-art.patch` (0010 and 0011 were taken by earlier patches):
  - `Shape::{Nes(NesShell), Snes(SnesShell)}` and their `spec()` arms (label box, mask, depth, detail, max_px, rim, board) in `slot: crates/slot-ui/src/cart.rs`;
  - `seated_box`/`cart_box` arms (`slot: crates/slot-ui/src/cart.rs:157-164`);
  - `slot: crates/slot-ui/src/silhouette.rs` silhouettes and lettering;
  - shelf shadows per new shape, following `slot: crates/slot/src/frontend.rs:197-204`, plus new setters;
  - label cache size per variant;
  - `slot: crates/slot-ui/src/shell.rs` tables `NES_TITLES`/`SNES_TITLES`, keyed by No-Intro title with tags stripped, containing only rows cited in `VARIANTS.md`;
  - `shell_presets()` entries appended after the upstream ones.
  - Not done as written: upstream `slot-ui/tests/shell.rs` asserts `shell_presets().len() == 25`, so appending breaks an upstream test, and changing the 25 is a value edit that CONTRIBUTING section 1 sends to the maintainer. `shell_presets()` is unchanged; the six new presets are `retro_presets()` in `retro_shell.rs` and T40 pins the upstream 25 as the prefix. Needs a maintainer decision on a guard site for the count.
- [x] `evals/eval-cart-likeness.sh` (two blind reviews, both 4/4, see below): render variants via T38, pair each with `docs/cart-art/refs/<variant>.jpg`; a blind reviewer compares renders against reference photos with labels stripped and order shuffled; pass at 4/4 matched and none "unrecognisable".
- [x] `evals/eval-colour-sources.sh`: every row of `NES_TITLES`/`SNES_TITLES` has a `VARIANTS.md` row with a URL; fail on any orphan.

## Tests
| ID | File | Asserts |
|---|---|---|
| T37 | `slot-ui/tests/nes_shell.rs` | Notable-cart lookups: each verified row maps; keys unique |
| T38 | `slot-ui/tests/render_nes_shelves.rs` | Render 4 variants (HeadlessSurface, macOS): mask inside `seated_box`/`cart_box`; shadow under the cart; label inside its box |
| T40 | `slot-ui/tests/nes_presets.rs` | `shell_presets()`: upstream presets are a prefix in the same order |

Upstream slot-ui tests stay unmodified and green, including `slot: crates/slot-ui/tests/board.rs` and every `render_*.rs`.

## Acceptance
- [x] T37, T38, T40 green.
- [x] `evals/eval-cart-likeness.sh` and `evals/eval-colour-sources.sh` pass. Colour sources passes (5 rows); likeness PASS 4/4 in two blind rounds.
- [x] GBA harness compare 0 diffs (`task check` 2026-10-13: compare 0 diffs H1, H1G, H2, B1, H3); GB/GBA cart renders unchanged (checked: 49 of 60 upstream render PNGs byte identical before and after, the other 11 differ only in a 20 x 13 px clock readout that also differs between two runs of the same tree).
- [x] Binary assets survive `task patches:check`.

## Device check (RG34XXSP)
None separate. The mixed-shelf check is in the phase device check in 24-phase-4-cart-art.

## Review notes
- Build step 25: only research-verified table entries, each with a cited source.
- `shell_presets()` order is append-only; upstream entries must stay a prefix.
- PNG and SVG assets must be exported with `--binary` (the export rule lives in 02-patch-pipeline).
- 2026-10-15, patch 0023 (label-top): a NES or SNES label scan taller than its label box loses rows from the bottom, not the middle, so the printed title at the top stays (issue 41). Wider scans keep the centred horizontal crop; GBA, GB and GBC labels are unchanged.

## Blind likeness reviews (2026-10-13)
- Round 1 (first art): a blind reviewer given only the shuffled, unlabelled renders and reference photos matched 4/4 (`eval-cart-likeness.sh score`: PASS). Its fixes for Famicom, NES and SFC were applied where the photos and VARIANTS.md support them; skipped items and reasons are in the PR.
- Round 2 (after the art round), a fresh reviewer: 4/4 matched again (NES high, Famicom high, SNES medium, SFC medium confidence). Remaining notes: raised bevelled labels (kept, slot's GBA carts use the same style), no stepped depth on the US SNES (only reference is an oblique stacked photo), no slot divider on the SFC.
